notes: Activity definitions and the 'installed' criterion are NOT confirmed by the site/construction lead. definition_status must be changed by a human after confirmation. Nothing in this file is applied to a site automatically: site configs declare targets and applicability (default 'unknown').

object_classes.source: No object class-ID mapping exists in qa_v2/qa_v3 (checked 2026-10-13: no label_map/class_id in code). IDs below were fixed from the label set observed in SITE_A output JSON (300-file sample: wall, floor, metal stud framing, ceiling, construction materials, Tools, person, unidentifiable, HVAC ductwork). Labels are matched case-insensitively after trimming.

layers.policy: Overlap between different layers is treated as a legitimate occlusion: the front layer wins. Overlap between different classes in the SAME layer is a conflict and becomes ignore (255). Overlap of shapes with the same class is a union. JSON shape order is never used.

occluder_labels.use: Object polygons of these labels inside a target ROI become occlusion *candidates* (draft). In training export they are ignored (255) unless --no-auto-occluder-ignore is given.

wall_board_installation.installs: wall board (e.g. gypsum board) fastened over wall framing
wall_board_installation.installed_criterion: UNCONFIRMED - e.g. board fastened over framing regardless of taping/finish
labeling_guidance: Boards leaning against the wall/framing are NOT installed: mark that area occluded (or undeterminable), never installed.
Existing surface visible behind open framing is not new board.
A bright panel alone does not prove board installation; joint/fastener evidence or context is needed.
Paint coat count / final inspection is not judged from a white wall.

floor_finish_installation.installs: floor finish material (type to be confirmed: tile / vinyl / carpet / ...)
labeling_guidance: Floor protection (paper/board/film) hides the finish: mark covered area undeterminable (reason covered_by_protection).
Removal of protection is NOT the finish completion time.

ceiling_panel_installation.installs: ceiling panels or ceiling board (type to be confirmed)
labeling_guidance: The ceiling may be an exposed (open) design: keep applicability 'unknown' until confirmed; exposed structure is not 'not_installed' by itself.

visibility_export.notes: visible = inside an ROI and not marked occluded/undeterminable. It does NOT mean the state is known.

roi_definitions.measurement_roi: The target surface or work zone to be evaluated (full extent, including not-yet-installed and occluded parts). Openings/doors that are not part of the work are explicit exclusions.
roi_definitions.object_mask: Area recognized as wall/floor/ceiling etc. in one photo (existing JSON). Not the ROI and not a state label.
roi_definitions.observable_region: Part of the measurement ROI that can be judged in that photo (ROI minus occlusion / undeterminable). Occlusion never shrinks the ROI.

ratio_semantics: Pixel ratios are 'installed share within the observable image area of the target ROI'. They are not real-area progress, not store-wide progress and carry no perspective correction or activity weighting.
